DIAGNOSIS READY: Chronic Bronchitis (COPD) with possible post-infectious airway inflammation.

The yellow sputum, orthopnea, and chest tightness without heart failure biomarkers or structural defects point more strongly toward a chronic airway obstruction or infection rather than heart failure. Do you smoke or have a history of long-term exposure to dust or chemicals?
